head: Google Find Hub now warns you when you leave a tracker tag behind
dek: Google's Find Hub on Android can now notify you when a tracker tag is separated from your phone. It's showing up for Chipolo trackers and the Moto Tag in version 3.1.787 for US and European users.
details: Your home address saved in your Google Account is left out by default, so you won't get alerts there. It doesn't appear for other devices, like headphones.
where: Android, Find Hub app, Chipolo and Moto Tag trackers
means: If you keep a tracker on your keys or bag, your phone can now tell you when you walk away without it.
todo: Open Find Hub, pick a tag, tap the settings gear and turn on "Notify when left behind".
